injuryCountdown.note: The initial kind-65 countdown precedes the new-game restart; later life-byte 4, 3 and 2 injuries use kind 65. The final 1-to-0 loss uses kind 69 and ends in kind 21.

limits: Source X and timer writes may straddle displayed frames. The pure helpers accept externally scheduled actor-update events only for the measured kind-64 knockback, kind-65 life-byte 1-4 countdowns, and final kind-69 life-byte-1 countdown in room 168. They do not infer contact-to-injury timing, generalize room collisions or trigger the subsequent menu/game-over flow.
